Two short full-body lifts to keep force and speed online without stealing from camp. Tuesday carries the slightly stronger maintenance signal; Friday stays deliberately cheaper and recovery-contingent so you leave the gym feeling better, not flatter.

Weeks 2-4: only the Tuesday weighted Pull-up nudges up in Week 2 if Week 1 stayed crisp. Week 3 trims volume while keeping familiar speed and loading. Week 4 is a competition-week primer: same patterns, tiny dose, no grinders.

Knee guidance: no heavy bilateral squatting in this block. If knee ache climbs above your normal camp baseline, keep Prowler Push short and sharp, hold Barbell Hip Thrust load steady or cut one set, and do not chase extra warm-up or back-off volume. If anything lower-body feels slower instead of sharper, stop there.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Tue	[WARMUP] Bike	Easy spin	1	3 min	N/A	N/A	Easy reset only; then take 1-2 quick ramp sets into the first loaded lifts.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	Pull-up	RPE-selected load	3	2	150 sec	7.5	Up to 3 sets; stop after 2 if RPE would exceed 8, elbows or shoulders feel off, or rep speed clearly fades.	
Tue	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	2	4	120 sec	7	Explosive up and controlled down; hold load or cut 1 set if you feel slow after MMA.	
Tue	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	5	75 sec	7	Keep it crisp and braced; support work only, no grinding.	
Tue	Push-up	RPE-selected load	2	5	75 sec	7	Use external load only if reps stay fast and clean; stop 2-3 reps before any grind.	
Tue	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	30 sec/side	30 sec	6	Trunk stiffness only; stop short of shaking.	
Tue	Prowler Push	RPE-selected load	4	15 m	120 sec	N/A	Fast crisp drives with full resets; this is a power primer, not conditioning; stop if speed drops.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Bike	Easy spin	1	3 min	N/A	N/A	Very short reset before a low-cost full-body session; then take 1-2 quick ramp sets into the first loaded lifts.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Fri	Pull-up	RPE-selected load	2	2	150 sec	6.5	Recovery-contingent touch; stop after 1 set if elbows, shoulders, or bar speed are not clean.	
Fri	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	2	3	120 sec	6.5	Familiar low-fatigue lower-body work only; no grind and no soreness chase.	
Fri	Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	5	75 sec	6.5	Stay crisp; this is support work, not a fatigue set.	
Fri	Push-up	RPE-selected load	2	4	75 sec	6.5	Use a load that stays fast; leave reps in reserve.	
Fri	Neck Isometric	Manual resistance	2	15 sec each direction	30 sec	6	First row to remove if Friday MMA already took too much out of you.	
Fri	Prowler Push	RPE-selected load	3	10 m	90 sec	N/A	Low-cost speed primer; lighter than Tuesday; full reset each push and stop before speed drops.	
END_WEEK1_TSV
